Reproduces experimental/schematic panels of main Figure 5: CEBPA locus track and nile-red staining result plots. Inputs (examples): output/fig5_c.nile_red.stain.Results.csv. Outputs: outplots/fig5_*.pdf.
--> 

fig5 实验用图

# fig5_a.CEBPA 的轨道图
```{r}

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

## ============================================================
## Gviz genomic track plot
## Genome: hg19
## Region: chr19:33,786,000-33,796,000
## Tracks:
##   1. Genome coordinate axis
##   2. Gene annotation
##   3. ChIP-seq BigWig 1
##   4. ChIP-seq BigWig 2
##   5. BED annotation 1
##   6. BED annotation 2
## ============================================================


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. 安装依赖：首次运行时执行
## ------------------------------------------------------------

# if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
#     install.packages("BiocManager")
# }
#
# BiocManager::install(
#     c(
#         "Gviz",
#         "rtracklayer",
#         "GenomicRanges",
#         "GenomeInfoDb",
#         "AnnotationDbi",
#         "TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene",
#         "org.Hs.eg.db"
#     ),
#     ask = FALSE,
#     update = FALSE
# )


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. 加载依赖
## ------------------------------------------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Gviz)
    library(rtracklayer)
    library(GenomicRanges)
    library(GenomeInfoDb)
    library(AnnotationDbi)
    library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene)
    library(org.Hs.eg.db)
})


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. 基础参数
## ------------------------------------------------------------

genome_name <- "hg19"
chromosome  <- "chr19"

plot_from <- 33786000L
plot_to   <- 33796000L


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. 输入文件
## 请替换为自己的实际路径
## ------------------------------------------------------------

bw1_file  <- "~/Project/chromHMM/bamsubtract/H3K27me3_15d-7d.log2.50bp.CPM.bw"
bw2_file  <- "~/Project/chromHMM/bamsubtract/H3K27ac_7d-0d.log2.50bp.CPM.bw"

bed1_file <- "../roi_info.split.bed"
bed2_file <- "../sgRNA.bed"


## 轨道名称
bw1_name  <- "delta H3K27me3"
bw2_name  <- "delta H3K27ac"

bed1_name <- "CRRs"
bed2_name <- "sgRNA"


## 输出文件
output_pdf <- "outplots/fig5/fig5_a.CEBPA.gviz.pdf"


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 5. 检查输入文件
## ------------------------------------------------------------

input_files <- c(
    bw1_file,
    bw2_file,
    bed1_file,
    bed2_file
)

missing_files <- input_files[!file.exists(input_files)]

if (length(missing_files) > 0L) {
    stop(
        paste0(
            "以下输入文件不存在：\n",
            paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n")
        )
    )
}


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 6. 定义绘图区间
## ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_region <- GRanges(
    seqnames = chromosome,
    ranges   = IRanges(
        start = plot_from,
        end   = plot_to
    )
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 7. BED读取函数
## ------------------------------------------------------------

read_bed_region <- function(
    bed_file,
    region,
    chromosome
) {

    bed_gr <- rtracklayer::import(
        bed_file,
        format = "BED"
    )

    ## 如果BED使用19而不是chr19，则只修正当前染色体名称
    if (!chromosome %in% seqlevels(bed_gr)) {

        chromosome_without_chr <- sub(
            pattern = "^chr",
            replacement = "",
            x = chromosome
        )

        if (chromosome_without_chr %in% seqlevels(bed_gr)) {

            rename_map <- setNames(
                chromosome,
                chromosome_without_chr
            )

            bed_gr <- GenomeInfoDb::renameSeqlevels(
                bed_gr,
                rename_map
            )
        }
    }

    if (!chromosome %in% seqlevels(bed_gr)) {
        stop(
            paste0(
                "BED文件中没有找到染色体 ",
                chromosome,
                "：",
                bed_file
            )
        )
    }

    ## 只保留当前绘图区间
    bed_gr <- subsetByOverlaps(
        bed_gr,
        region,
        ignore.strand = TRUE
    )

    if (length(bed_gr) == 0L) {
        stop(
            paste0(
                "BED文件在绘图区间内没有任何重叠区域：\n",
                bed_file
            )
        )
    }

    bed_gr
}


bed1_gr <- read_bed_region(
    bed_file  = bed1_file,
    region    = plot_region,
    chromosome = chromosome
)

bed2_gr <- read_bed_region(
    bed_file  = bed2_file,
    region    = plot_region,
    chromosome = chromosome
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 8. 创建基因组坐标轴
## ------------------------------------------------------------

axis_track <- GenomeAxisTrack(
    name        = "",
    littleTicks = TRUE,
    add53       = TRUE,
    add35       = TRUE,
    cex         = 0.8,
    fontcolor   = "black",
    col         = "black"
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 9. 创建hg19基因注释轨道
## ------------------------------------------------------------

txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19.knownGene

gene_track <- GeneRegionTrack(
    txdb,
    genome               = genome_name,
    chromosome           = chromosome,
    start                = plot_from,
    end                  = plot_to,
    name                 = "Genes",
    stacking             = "squish",
    showId               = TRUE,
    geneSymbol           = TRUE,
    transcriptAnnotation = "symbol",
    fill                 = "#606060",
    col                  = "#303030",
    cex                  = 0.8,
    background.panel     = "white",
    background.title     = "white",
    col.title            = "black",
    col.axis             = "black"
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 10. 将Entrez Gene ID转换为gene symbol
## TxDb本身通常只保存Entrez Gene ID
## ------------------------------------------------------------

gene_ids <- as.character(gene(gene_track))

valid_gene_ids <- (
    !is.na(gene_ids) &
    nzchar(gene_ids)
)

gene_symbols <- rep(
    NA_character_,
    length(gene_ids)
)

if (any(valid_gene_ids)) {

    gene_id_map <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
        org.Hs.eg.db,
        keys      = unique(gene_ids[valid_gene_ids]),
        column    = "SYMBOL",
        keytype   = "ENTREZID",
        multiVals = "first"
    )

    gene_symbols[valid_gene_ids] <- unname(
        gene_id_map[gene_ids[valid_gene_ids]]
    )
}

## 如果没有找到symbol，则保留原始gene ID
missing_symbols <- (
    is.na(gene_symbols) |
    !nzchar(gene_symbols)
)

gene_symbols[missing_symbols] <- gene_ids[missing_symbols]

symbol(gene_track) <- gene_symbols


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 11. 创建BigWig信号轨道
## ------------------------------------------------------------

bw1_track <- DataTrack(
    range            = normalizePath(bw1_file),
    genome           = genome_name,
    chromosome       = chromosome,
    name             = bw1_name,
    type             = "histogram",
    baseline         = 0,
    col.histogram    = "#3B6FB6",
    fill.histogram   = "#3B6FB6",
    background.panel = "white",
    background.title = "white",
    col.title        = "black",
    col.axis         = "black",
    col.frame        = "#BFBFBF",
    cex.title        = 0.8,
    cex.axis         = 0.75
)

bw2_track <- DataTrack(
    range            = normalizePath(bw2_file),
    genome           = genome_name,
    chromosome       = chromosome,
    name             = bw2_name,
    type             = "histogram",
    baseline         = 0,
    col.histogram    = "#B84A4A",
    fill.histogram   = "#B84A4A",
    background.panel = "white",
    background.title = "white",
    col.title        = "black",
    col.axis         = "black",
    col.frame        = "#BFBFBF",
    cex.title        = 0.8,
    cex.axis         = 0.75
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 12. 创建BED色块轨道
## ------------------------------------------------------------

make_bed_track <- function(
    bed_gr,
    track_name,
    track_color
) {

    ## 如果BED存在第4列name，则将其保留为区域ID
    if ("name" %in% colnames(mcols(bed_gr))) {

        region_ids <- as.character(
            mcols(bed_gr)$name
        )

    } else {

        region_ids <- paste0(
            "region_",
            seq_along(bed_gr)
        )
    }

    AnnotationTrack(
        range            = bed_gr,
        genome           = genome_name,
        chromosome       = chromosome,
        name             = track_name,
        id               = region_ids,
        showId           = FALSE,
        stacking         = "dense",
        shape            = "box",
        fill             = track_color,
        col              = track_color,
        background.panel = "white",
        background.title = "white",
        col.title        = "black",
        col.axis         = "black",
        col.frame        = "#BFBFBF",
        cex.title        = 0.8,
        min.height       = 5
    )
}


bed1_track <- make_bed_track(
    bed_gr      = bed1_gr,
    track_name  = bed1_name,
    track_color = "#E2A13A"
)

bed2_track <- make_bed_track(
    bed_gr      = bed2_gr,
    track_name  = bed2_name,
    track_color = "#4D9A6A"
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 13. 组合轨道
## ------------------------------------------------------------

track_list <- list(
    axis_track,
    gene_track,
    bed2_track,
    bw1_track,
    bw2_track,
    bed1_track
)

## 各轨道相对高度
track_sizes <- c(
    1.0,   # 坐标轴
    1.4,   # 基因
    0.6,    # BED 2
    2.0,   # BigWig 1
    2.0,   # BigWig 2
    0.6   # BED 1
)


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 14. 绘图函数
## ------------------------------------------------------------

draw_gviz_tracks <- function() {

    plotTracks(
        track_list,
        chromosome           = chromosome,
        from                 = plot_from,
        to                   = plot_to,
        sizes                = track_sizes,

        ## 每个基因只显示最长转录本
        collapseTranscripts  = "longest",

        transcriptAnnotation = "symbol",
        geneSymbol           = TRUE,
        showId               = TRUE,

        main = paste0(
            chromosome,
            ":",
            format(plot_from, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
            "-",
            format(plot_to, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
            " (",
            genome_name,
            ")"
        ),

        title.width      = 1.25,
        fontfamily      = "sans",
        background.title = "white",
        col.title       = "black",
        col.axis        = "black",
        col.border.title = "#BFBFBF",
        cex.title       = 0.8,
        cex.axis        = 0.8
    )
}


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 15. 输出PDF
## ------------------------------------------------------------

pdf(
    file        = output_pdf,
    width       = 12,
    height      = 8,
    useDingbats = FALSE
)

draw_gviz_tracks()

dev.off()

message(
    "绘图完成：",
    normalizePath(output_pdf)
)

```


# fig5_d.染色脂滴定量统计图
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- read.table(file = "output/fig5_c.nile_red.stain.Results.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 设置组别顺序，并确保测量值是数值型
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = c("sgNC", "sgRNA1", "sgRNA2")
    ),
    Percentage_Area = as.numeric(Percentage_Area)
  )

# 计算sgNC的均值
sgNC_mean <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(category == "sgNC") %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(Percentage_Area, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(mean_value)

sgNC_mean

df_normalized <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Relative_Area = Percentage_Area / sgNC_mean
  )

df_normalized %>%
  dplyr::select(Label, category, Percentage_Area, Relative_Area)

t.test(df_normalized[df_normalized$category == "sgNC","Relative_Area"],
       df_normalized[df_normalized$category == "sgRNA1","Relative_Area"])

t.test(df_normalized[df_normalized$category == "sgNC","Relative_Area"],
       df_normalized[df_normalized$category == "sgRNA2","Relative_Area"])


summary_df <- df_normalized %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(Relative_Area)),
    mean = mean(Relative_Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Relative_Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_df

p <- ggplot() +
  # 各组均值柱
  geom_col(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(
      x = category,
      y = mean,
      fill = category
    ),
    width = 0.68,
    color = NA
  ) +

  # 均值 ± SEM
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_df,
    aes(
      x = category,
      ymin = mean - sem,
      ymax = mean + sem
    ),
    width = 0.24,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # 归一化后的每张图像数据点
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_normalized,
    aes(
      x = category,
      y = Relative_Area
    ),
    width = 0.09,
    height = 0,
    shape = 15,
    size = 3,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "sgNC" = "#888888",
      "sgRNA1" = "#514CFF",
      "sgRNA2" = "#B2B2F4"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "sgNC" = "sgNC",
      "sgRNA1" = "sgRNA1",
      "sgRNA2" = "sgRNA2"
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative Nile Red-positive area"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "none",

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 16,
      color = "black",
      margin = margin(r = 8)
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 16,
      color = "black"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 16,
      color = "black",
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    ),

    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "black"
    ),

    axis.ticks = element_line(
      color = "black"
    ),

    axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"),

    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
  )

ggsave(p,file = "outplots/fig5_d.nile_red.stain.pdf", width = 4, height = 4.8, units = "in", dpi = 300)


```
